standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.npc: Hmm... Wish I had a cat to talk to.
Erm, hello? Can you understand me?

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.player: I certainly can. I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.npc: Ah so you've met some of the local felines. Wise and confusing, those Sphinges.

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.player: Wow!! You know the plural of Sphinx!! What else do you know?

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.npc: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels. Want to hear one?

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.player: I certainly do. Share your wisdom Bob!

standard-dialogue-while-wearing-a-catspe.text: Bob then says a tidbit of wisdom.

steps.player: Hi Bob, how's tricks?

steps.npc: Tricks? Dogs are for tricks! Cats are for admiring and fussing over.

steps.player: OK then, how about a joke instead?

steps.npc: Woof woof. Yip yip!

steps.player: Excuse me?

steps.npc: Ah, don't mind me. I am learning a second language!

steps.player: No, you don't understand. I wanted to hear a joke.

steps.npc: Sigh... OK. Did you hear about the cat who drank 10 bowls of milk? He set a new lap record.

steps.player: Did he? Wow. What about this joke then?

steps.npc: Are you trying to be funny?

steps.player: No, that's your job isn't it?

steps.npc: Grrrowl. OK, last try. What do you call a cat that lives in an igloo?.... An Eskimew!

steps.player: An Eskimew... That's not funny. I waited all this time for that? Sheesh.

steps.npc: You know, sometimes I wonder why I still bother with this place. It's just not the same since the humans arrived.

options.text: Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!

steps.player: Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!

steps.npc: Advice you want eh? Well, I could just enlighten you with a snippet of my vast knowledge.

steps.player: That would be fantastic! I heard you were very very wise indeed.

steps.npc: Well, I think I will let you decide that.

steps.player: OK, bamboozle me with your intelligence!

steps.text: Bob then says a tidbit of wisdom.

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.player: Do you two know each other?

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.npc: Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.speaker: Cat
standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.text: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.npc: You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.speaker: Cat
standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.text: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!

standard-dialogue-while-having-a-cat-fol.player: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-ca.npc: [player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-ca.player: I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-ca.npc: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-ca.player: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.

location-specific-falador.player: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?

location-specific-falador.npc: Yes I guess so. But I've been asked to get some coal for Dunstan. He ran out, you see.

location-specific-falador.player: Anything I can do to help?

location-specific-falador.npc: No thanks. I'm on my way back now.

location-specific-lumbridge.player: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?

location-specific-lumbridge.npc: Yes, but the fish round here are oh so tasty! And there's nobody who can make a good old fashioned seafood gumbo like the Lumbridge cook!
Oh yes, an old recipe passed down from generation to generation of cooks. But this might be the last generation since the Duke's current cook doesn't have any children.

location-specific-lumbridge.player: Ah, I will have to ask him for the recipe then.

location-specific-lumbridge.npc: Oh, I wouldn't do that if I were you, he's very sensitive about his gumbo responsibilities. I'm sure that if you're a good enough fisherman and cook the knowledge will reach you one day.

location-specific-lumbridge.player: OK, I shan't bring it up with him. Cheers for the chat Bob.

location-specific-lumbridge.npc: No problem. Just make sure you bring me some of you ever get the chance to make it. I love that gumbo!

location-specific-taverley.player: Hi Bob. What are you doing here?

location-specific-taverley.npc: Ah, another person who thinks I want to talk to them just because they can understand me.
OK, you asked what I'm doing here.

I'm here to study the druids. They're boring, but they know how to treat animals, and they don't go around bothering you just because they've got a silly gadget that lets them understand what you say!

location-specific-varrock.player: Hi Bob. What are you doing hanging around Varrock?

location-specific-varrock.npc: Not much. Just came to see how things are going. Not visited here in a while you see. Me and Roald used to talk all the time.
Well, those white knights are far more complicated than you might imagine. Not the ‘goodie goodies' they claim to be. Just watch your back.

location-specific-seers-village.player: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?

location-specific-seers-village.npc: Yikes!! Where did you pop up from?

location-specific-seers-village.player: Oh sorry Bob, didn't mean to make you jump.

location-specific-seers-village.npc: Noooooo. Now that mouse I was chasing has got away. Can you be a bit more sneaky next time? You know, sneaky sneaky stick da chompy as my old friend Rantz often says.

location-specific-ardougne.player: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?

location-specific-ardougne.npc: Argh! My thumbs have gone weird!

location-specific-ardougne.player: But Bob, you don't have any thumbs!

location-specific-ardougne.npc: Exactly!! Clearly I must go home, the sky's beginning to bruise, night must fall and I shall be forced to camp.
No, not really. I've just had a severe disappointment.

location-specific-ardougne.player: Whats up Bob, lost your favorite toy?

location-specific-ardougne.npc: No, it's just that there comes a time in every cats life where he realises how much time he has wasted just.... playing with rats.

location-specific-ardougne.player: Doesn't sound like a waste of time to me! They deserve it!

location-specific-ardougne.npc: Ahh, I guess your right. Thanks!

location-specific-port-sarim.player: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?

location-specific-port-sarim.npc: Actually no. I come from round here originally. Back then all this was just fields.

location-specific-port-sarim.player: Back then? How old are you Bob?

location-specific-port-sarim.npc: Ha! How old indeed. How old are the trees? How old are the waves that crash against the shore? How old is the stone we walk on?

location-specific-port-sarim.player: I see. Cryptic as ever. Cheers Bob.... I think.

steps.npc: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
Now, where did the rest of my PK clan go?
Be wery, wery quiet... I'm hunting pwayers.
Ah, don't mind me. I'm just looting bodies.
Look out!! He's over there!! Run!!
You know, my feet are knackered. This walking lark isn't all it's cracked up to be. Give me a nice monitor to sleep on any day.
In this place it's not HOW you die that matters. It's who you take with you.
Those who live by the sword, die by the mage.
Did you see that? Someone with a big shiny new halberd hiding behind that rock. I thought only rangers acted as cowardly as that.

steps.player: Are you really just a cat Bob?

steps.npc: Apparently so yes. Well, that's what they told me after the experiment.

steps.player: What experiment?

steps.npc: Yes. There was this professor called 'Oddenstein' I think. He must have tricked me into that machine of his, then the next thing I knew I was feline!

steps.player: Oddenstein? I am sure I have heard that name...

steps.npc: Yes. Once the authorities found out about his experiments he ran away. Lucky for him or I would scratch his eyes out.

steps.player: Is this really all true? Sounds a bit suspicious to me.

steps.npc: Never question the logic of a cat, however flawed.

steps.player: Flawed? So it isn't true... so, erm, eh?

steps.npc: Perhaps one day you will learn the truth. Until then, the Oddenstein story is what we will tell the 'others'. Understood?

steps.player: OK. Your secrets safe with me Bob.
This is a long way from Burthorpe. What you doing out here?

steps.npc: I am drawing a picture of that thing over there.

steps.player: Really? What thing?

steps.npc: That gullible thing over there. Next to that tree where that man sometimes stands.

steps.player: Wow. Could you be any more vague and sarcastic?

steps.npc: Probably. It's just no challenge these days.

steps.player: It's not safe here Bob. You should leave.

steps.npc: No way. I am here catching mice.

steps.player: But there aren't any mice in the Wilderness.

steps.npc: Ahh, the human shows signs of a brain. Why do you think that is?

steps.player: Because you caught them all?

steps.npc: Exactly. Well done!

wisdom.player: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?

steps.npc: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.

steps.player: Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.

steps.npc: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.

steps.player: I knew it!!

steps.npc: Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!

steps.player: Hee hee. OK Bob.

steps.npc: Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!

steps.player: What do you believe, Bob?

steps.npc: Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?

steps.player: Hee hee. OK Bob.

steps.npc: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.

steps.player: Eh?

steps.npc: Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
Nothing interesting happens.

steps.player: Eh? That's hardly useful.

steps.npc: Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.

steps.player: Like what?

steps.npc: Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.

steps.player: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?

steps.npc: Yes, that's about it.

steps.player: OK... I see.... I think.

steps.npc: Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?

steps.player: Must be all that washing you do.

steps.npc: You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?

steps.player: Eeeww. Gross.

steps.npc: Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.

steps.player: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.

steps.npc: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.

steps.player: I'll be waiting.

steps.npc: Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
Do you like dogs?

steps.player: Yes!

steps.npc: Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.

steps.player: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.

steps.npc: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.

steps.player: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.

steps.npc: What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?

steps.player: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.

steps.npc: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
Mmm. Maybe another time.
Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
it was done on purpose.
Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!

steps.player: Do you like all the monsters around here?

steps.npc: No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!

steps.player: That's a bit cruel isn't it?

steps.npc: Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!

reclaiming-mouse-toy.player: Hi Bob! Do you have another one of those mouse toys? I lost mine.
You know, a fake mouse on a string.

reclaiming-mouse-toy.npc: An Advanced Combat Training Device, every cat should have one. Here's another one.

reclaiming-mouse-toy.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.player: I don't have the space, one second.
